texts.zh: [From.GetName]的最新传感器读数显示恒星在有规律地悸动，但当[Root.GetName]的船员们抵达当地时，却没有发现支持这一数据的证据。尽管大多数船员都同意这是传感器故障引起的，[Root.GetLeaderName]却否认这一理论。[Root.GetLeaderName]宣称在别处发现了类似的悸动能源放射规律，并担心星系中的恒星正在遭遇怪事。[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHeCap]已安排了前往最近的受影响恒星的航线。
texts.en: The latest sensory readings from [From.GetName] showed the star pulsating regularly, but when the crew on [Root.GetName] arrived on site there was no evidence to support this data. While most of the crew are in agreement that the anomaly was caused by a sensory malfunction, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] discards this theory. [Root.GetLeaderName] claims to have discovered similar pulsating energy emission patterns elsewhere and now fears that something strange is happening to the galaxy's stars. They have charted the course to the nearest affected star.

label.en: We must get to the bottom of this...

texts.zh:
数日沉思后，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]出面承认了自己犯下的错误——遥远的恒星脉冲没有隐藏规律，也没有不祥的、形而上学的意图。正如[Root.GetLeaderName]所言：

“偏执，如此而已。作为科学家，这不合逻辑、毫无计划，也着实不被欢迎。”

尽管看上去很尴尬，这篓子倒并非什么好处都没有；毕竟[Root.GetLeaderName]内心的斗争让其好好地审视了自己。
texts.en:
After a few days of heavy brooding, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is ready to admit that a mistake was made. There is no hidden pattern in faraway star pulses, no ominous, metaphysical intent. As [Root.GetLeaderName] described it:

'It was paranoia, plain and simple. Illogical, erratic and quite unbecoming of a scientist.'

Embarrassing as it may have been, this blunder was not entirely without benefit, as [Root.GetLeaderName]'s inner conflict led to some valuable self-discovery.

texts.zh: 当船员们抵达[anomalous_star.GetName]时，他们确认传感器确实故障了。好消息是他们不仅大大低估了行星能量输出的初步估计，而且[From.GetLeaderName]似乎也从过去的错误中学到了教训。
texts.en: On the crew's arrival to [anomalous_star.GetName] they were able to confirm that their sensors were indeed malfunctioning. The good news is that not only were their initial estimates for the star's energy output grossly understated, [From.GetLeaderName] seems to have learned from past mistakes.

label.en: Failure is but a stepping stone to success.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的船员们不幸地发现，正如他们所料，我们从[anomalous_star.GetName]观测到的悸动规律确实是传感器故障……没错，是科学专员[crazy_science_officer.GetName]脑子里的那个传感器坏了。

科学专员的行为变得很不稳定。[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe]得了妄想症，自认为是世界的守护者，而恒星的悸动预示着世界末日即将到来。船员们认为[crazy_science_officer.GetHerselfHimself]在精神病发作时篡改了舰船的传感器数据。

该科学专员目前正在一个前往[Root.Capital.GetName]的医疗舱中，[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe]将会在那里接受治疗。
texts.en:
The crew of the [From.GetName] has made an unfortunate discovery. Just as they suspected, the pulsating pattern we observed from [anomalous_star.GetName] was in fact due to a sensory malfunction... in Science Officer [crazy_science_officer.GetName]'s head.

The Science Officer's behavior has turned erratic. [crazy_science_officer.GetHeSheCap] suffers delusions about the stars broadcasting coded warnings about a coming apocalypse - and of having been appointed Protector of the Realm. The crew believes [crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe] [crazy_science_officer.GetHerselfHimself] manipulated the ship's sensory data during one such psychotic spell.

Science Officer [crazy_science_officer.GetName] is now in a medical pod headed back to [Root.Capital.GetName], where [crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe] will receive proper treatment.

label.zh: 感谢你的贡献，世界的守护者[crazy_science_officer.GetName]！
label.en: Thank you for your service, Protector of the Realm [crazy_science_officer.GetName]!

texts.zh: 星系中有数颗恒星开始奇怪地悸动。船员们担心这些读数是仪器故障造成的，但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]想要详细调查其中一颗恒星。
texts.en: Several stars in the galaxy have begun to pulsate oddly. The crew have raised concerns that these readings were caused by a sensory malfunction, but officer [Root.GetLeaderName] would like to investigate one of the stars more closely.
